The Untitled Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes sequel is an upcoming American science fiction action film. It is the fifth installment in the Planet of the Apes reboot film series and the eleventh film overall, serving as a standalone sequel to Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes (2024).
Production
Development
In October 2024, 20th Century president Steve Asbell revealed that a new Planet of the Apes film is in development for an expected 2027 release.
